title: Gray, black and one red box
label: Brand gallery
lede: One freely licensed photograph of the original cans exists that we could find. There are no website screenshots here: we did not confirm whether an official OK site was ever archived. The drawings are ours.

archive.caption: The four can designs used in the test markets. Time described them in 1994: a blank-looking young man, a can with no face at all and “a primitively drawn red face.”[^6]
archive.alt: Four OK Soda cans in a row, gray and silver with black drawings and a red-bordered OK box on each
archive.credit: Photo: TeemPlayer, via [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:OK_Soda_Original_4.jpg), CC BY-SA 3.0. The can artwork and trademarks belong to their owners; shown for commentary.
